title: "Unique Taxa 16s"

#1) Setup
##Load Packages
```{r 1.a packages}
for (lib in c('tidyverse','vegan','ggplot2','eulerr','ggplotify', 'ggpubr')) {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(lib, character.only = TRUE))
}
```
##read in data
```{r 1.b}
metadata <- read_csv('metadata_IFGvSBC.csv')

data.16 <- read_csv('feature_table_16S.csv')
taxonomy.16 <- read_tsv('taxonomy_16S.tsv')

data.18 <- read_csv('feature_table_18s.csv')
taxonomy.18 <- read_csv('taxonomy_18S.csv')
```
#2) Prevalance for 16s
##filter the data
```{r 2.a filter data and convert to presence/absence}
#get the samples less than a threshold of seq count
##set min-sequence count
count_cutoff <- 4000

drop_samples <- data.16 %>%
  select(-ASV_ID) %>% #remove ASV-ID column as it is non-numeric
  colSums() %>% #total counts per sample
  .[. < count_cutoff] %>% #filtering the named numbers by cuttoff
  names() 

data_drop <- data.16 %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_samples), -matches("PCR|Ext")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

#convert counts to presence/absence, merge with taxonomy
ft_16s_merge <- data_drop %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV_ID, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Counts") %>% #standard data transformation, each row is a unique ASV + Sample combo
  #left_join(taxonomy.16) %>% #join taxonomic asignments by ASV_ID
  #tidyr::unite(col = tax_string, Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus) %>%
  group_by(Sample, ASV_ID) %>%
  summarise(Counts = sum(Counts)) %>%
  mutate(Value = Counts/Counts) %>% #get our presence absence, if absent will generate NaN or if present will = 1
  mutate_all(~replace(.,is.nan(.), 0)) #convert NaN values to 0 to have a proper binary
```

##calculate the 'core' ASVs
```{r 2.b filter to prevalant taxa}
#set the proportion of samples the ASV is present in cuttoff
threshold = .8

prevalant_16 <- ft_16s_merge %>%
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  group_by(ASV_ID, IFG_SBC) %>%
  summarise(presence = sum(Value == 1) / n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(presence)) %>%
  filter(presence >= threshold) %>%
  left_join(taxonomy.16)
```

##pull lists of taxa and setup object for venn diagram
```{r 2.c pull the unique and shared taxa}
sbc <-  prevalant_16 %>%
  filter(IFG_SBC == "SBC") %>%
  pull(ASV_ID) 

ifg <- prevalant_16 %>%
  filter(IFG_SBC == "IFG") %>%
  pull(ASV_ID) 

sbc_unique <- sbc[!sbc %in% ifg]
ifg_unique <- ifg[!ifg %in% sbc]
shared <- intersect(ifg, sbc)

export.16 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Substrate = "SBC_Unique",  ASV_ID = sbc_unique),
  tibble(Substrate = "IFG_Unique",  ASV_ID = ifg_unique),
  tibble(Substrate = "Shared_taxa", ASV_ID = shared)
) %>%
  left_join(taxonomy.16, by = "ASV_ID")

#write_csv(export.16, "/Users/wjames/Desktop/PhD/SFT_NDIFG_SBCvS/Final_Figs/16s_prevalent_taxa.csv")

#fit the lists for euler to generate the venn diagram
sets_16 <- euler(list(IFG = ifg, SBC = sbc))
```

##plot the 16s venn diagram
```{r 2.d prevalance venn diagram}
venn_16s <- as.ggplot( #ggplotify here so that we can merge down the line and export neatly
  plot(sets_16,
       quantities = TRUE,          # show counts
       fills      = list(fill = c("darkcyan", "goldenrod2"), alpha = 0.4),
       edges      = list(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
       labels     = list(font = 2))
) + 
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))

#venn_16s
```

#3) Prevalence for 18s
```{r 3.a dataframe filtering}
#get the samples less than a threshold of seq count
##set min-sequence count
count_cutoff <- 10000

drop_samples <- data.18 %>%
  select(-ASV_ID) %>% #remove ASV-ID column as it is non-numeric
  colSums() %>% #total counts per sample
  .[. < count_cutoff] %>% #filtering the named numbers by cuttoff
  names() 

non.protist <- taxonomy.18 %>%
  filter(Phylum == 'p__Vertebrata' | Class %in% c("c__Insecta", "c__Arachnida") | Domain %in% c("d__Bacteria", "d__Archaea")) %>%
  pull(ASV_ID)

data_drop <- data.18 %>%
  filter(!ASV_ID %in% non.protist) %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_samples), -matches("PCR|Ext")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

ft_18s_merge <- data_drop %>%
  pivot_longer(-ASV_ID, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Counts") %>% #standard data transformation, each row is a unique ASV + Sample combo
  #left_join(taxonomy.18) %>% #join taxonomic asignments by ASV_ID
  #tidyr::unite(col = tax_string, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus) %>%
  group_by(Sample, ASV_ID) %>%
  summarise(Counts = sum(Counts)) %>%
  mutate(Value = Counts/Counts) %>% #get our presence absence, if absent will generate NaN or if present will = 1
  mutate_all(~replace(.,is.nan(.), 0)) #convert NaN values to 0 to have a proper binary
```

##calculate 'core' taxa
```{r 3.b calculate prevalance}
#set the proportion of samples the ASV is present in cuttoff
threshold = .8

prevalant_18 <- ft_18s_merge %>%
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  group_by(ASV_ID, IFG_SBC) %>%
  summarise(presence = sum(Value == 1) / n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(presence)) %>%
  filter(presence >= threshold) 
  
```

```{r 3.c get the ASV_IDs}
sbc <-  prevalant_18 %>%
  filter(IFG_SBC == "SBC") %>%
  pull(ASV_ID) 

ifg <- prevalant_18 %>%
  filter(IFG_SBC == "IFG") %>%
  pull(ASV_ID) 

sbc_unique <- sbc[!sbc %in% ifg]
ifg_unique <- ifg[!ifg %in% sbc]
shared <- intersect(ifg, sbc)

max_len <- max(length(sbc_unique), length(ifg_unique), length(shared))

export.18 <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Substrate = "SBC_Unique",  ASV_ID = sbc_unique),
  tibble(Substrate = "IFG_Unique",  ASV_ID = ifg_unique),
  tibble(Substrate = "Shared_taxa", ASV_ID = shared)
) %>%
  left_join(taxonomy.18, by = "ASV_ID")

#write_csv(export.18,"/Users/wjames/Desktop/PhD/SFT_NDIFG_SBCvS/Final_Figs/18s_prevalent_taxa.csv")

#fit the lists for euler to generate the venn diagram
sets_18 <- euler(list(IFG = ifg, SBC = sbc))
```

##plot the 18s venn diagram
```{r 3.d make the venn diagram}
venn_18s <- as.ggplot( #ggplotify here so that we can merge down the line and export neatly
  plot(sets_18,
       quantities = TRUE,          # show counts
       fills      = list(fill = c("darkcyan", "goldenrod2"), alpha = 0.4),
       edges      = list(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
       labels     = list(font = 2))
) + 
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))

#venn_18s
```

#4) Merge and Export the plots
```{r 4.a merge}
venn.2 <- ggarrange(venn_16s, venn_18s,
                    align = 'h',
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
                    labels = 'auto')

venn.2
```

```{r 4.b export}
ggsave(
  filename="Prevalance_Main.pdf",
  plot = venn.2,
  dpi = 600,
  width = 180,
  height = 90,
  units = 'mm'
)
```
